rtl_guidelines.tailwindcss_support: Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, pe-6 instead of pr-6, text-start instead of text-left) to seamlessly support both Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR).
rtl_guidelines.font_family_integration: IBM Plex Sans Arabic natively handles both Latin and Arabic scripts elegantly, maintaining the Swiss precision feel across both languages.
rtl_guidelines.icons: Ensure directional icons (arrows, chevrons, etc.) flip when in RTL mode (using `rtl:-scale-x-100` utility).

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold

typography.rules: Avoid center alignment for data-dense dashboards. Strict left (or start for RTL) alignment for all forms, tables, and metric cards.

surface_styles.navigation: bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90

layout_and_spacing.rules: Utilize grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI metric cards. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for complex charts and tables. Every surface must have a crisp 1px solid border with subtle ambient shadow.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0033A0] text-white hover:bg-[#002277] transition-colors rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium shadow-sm
buttons.ghost: text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-900 transition-colors rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium

components.inputs: bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0033A0]/20 focus:border-[#0033A0] transition-shadow
components.tables: w-full text-sm text-start. Headers should be uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs text-gray-500 bg-gray-50/50. Rows have border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50/50 transition-colors.
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border
components.shadcn_overrides: Remove heavy rounded corners. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (4px). Go flat and rectangular for a technical, Swiss feel.

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in for lists and grid items (framer-motion standard initial={{opacity:0, y:10}} animate={{opacity:1, y:0}})
animations.micro_interactions: Active states on navigation links translate slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) or feature a crisp active bottom-border.

image_urls.description: Low angle photography of gray building, geometric and professional.
Black and blue abstract geometric background.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain strictly WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum) on all text. The primary blue (#0033A0) on white has a high contrast ratio.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.focus_states: Ensure keyboard focus is visible using high-contrast ring utilities.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a highly functional, data-dense HR & Task Management dashboard for 'JAZ Platform'.

The application requires full Arabic RTL support. Use Tailwind logical properties (start, end, ps, pe, ms, me) instead of left/right properties to ensure the layout flips perfectly when direction is RTL.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' as the primary font for both Arabic and English text.
The UI should feel 'Swiss Brutalist'—functional, high contrast, avoiding unnecessary decorations, gradients, or soft blurred shadows.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the dashboards. The gaps should be tight, and the data should be clearly readable.
All navigation elements and actionable items must be strictly aligned and utilize a modular component structure.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to every clickable or interactable UI element.
For components, rely heavily on Shadcn UI but modify them to use sharp corners (rounded-sm or none) and remove heavy shadows in favor of 1px solid borders.
Do NOT use placeholder images from dummyimage.com; ONLY use the images provided in the image_urls array.
